question: The Gujarat Assembly, on 18 September 2023, approved a bill that reserves ____________ of local body seats specifically for Other Backward Classes (OBCs).
solution:
The correct answer is __**27%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Gujarat Assembly approved a bill on **18 September 2023** that reserves **27%** of local body seats specifically for Other Backward Classes (OBCs).
 
• This reservation aims to ensure better representation and participation of OBCs in local governance.
 
• The bill was passed with the intent to enhance the socio-political inclusion of OBC communities within the state.
 
• The move is expected to influence the composition and functioning of local bodies such as municipalities and panchayats.
 
• This legislative step aligns with the broader objectives of social justice and equitable distribution of political power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Backward Classes (OBCs)** are a collective term used by the Government of India to classify castes that are educationally or socially disadvantaged.
 
• The reservation for OBCs is part of India’s affirmative action policy to uplift marginalized communities.
 
• In addition to local body reservations, OBCs also benefit from reservations in educational institutions and government jobs.
 
• The **Constitution of India** allows for such reservations under Articles 15 and 16, which permit the state to make special provisions for the advancement of socially and educationally backward classes.
 
• The reservation policy is periodically reviewed and updated to reflect current socio-economic conditions.
